data_fields.name: bow_left_hand_switching
data_fields.donor_constant: setting BowLeftHandWithSwitching (boolean; bows Both or LeftOnly)

best_idea: Equipping resolves the target slot first, clears the hands a two-hander or shield needs, refuses before changing anything if the slot is taken and replacement is not allowed, and returns the displaced items so the caller can take their stat value off before adding the new one.
decision_why: Keep the hand exclusivity rules, the refuse-before-change check, the displaced-list return and the remove-before-add order for stats; drop the 27-slot table because Frankendom's equipment slots are its own and the bow setting is a client option.
acceptance: The hero holds a kite shield and the player equips a two-handed war axe: the shield leaves the left hand on the paper doll in the same frame, the armour line drops by the shield's value, and the shield appears in the bag. A server test asserts that equipping the axe returns exactly the shield in the displaced list, leaves the left hand empty and the right hand holding the axe, and that a refused equip changes no slot at all.
